svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Agents and orchestration: Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, Composio, Mem0. Retrieval and documents: Pinecone, pgvector, Cohere, Sentence Transformers, Docling, PyMuPDF. Models and inference: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, LLaMA, Whisper, Hugging Face, PyTorch. Backend and data: FastAPI, Django, Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, MongoDB, Pydantic. Frontend and apps: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, React Native, Expo, Chrome extensions, Tauri. Cloud and DevOps: AWS ECS, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel. Quality and observability: LangSmith, Sentry, CloudWatch, Pytest, Playwright, Vitest, Ruff. Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, C++.
